description: Ministry of City Planing & Water Supply - Duties & Functions assigned to the State Minister of City Planing & Water Supply
categorisation: This gazette names a specific individual (Rauff Hakeem, Minister of City Planning and Water Supply) AND provides detailed portfolio responsibilities and functions assigned to the State Minister, including specific projects (supply of safe drinking water, regulation of water supply and sanitation projects) and the government bodies/departments under their purview. This combination of named personnel and detailed responsibilities makes it a Hybrid Gazette.
